name: dlc-status
prompt: 查看PAI-DLC集群中任务的状态分布。执行dlc get job命令，统计各种状态（Succeeded/Failed/Running/EnvPreparing等）的任务数量。结果以清晰的表格形式展示。
command_args: echo '=== DLC任务状态分布 ===' && ./dlc get job --workspace_id 270969 --page_size 200 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Succeeded|Failed|Running|EnvPreparing|Creating|Queuing' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//' | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | awk '{printf "%-20s %3d\n", $2, $1}' && echo '' && echo '总计:' && ./dlc get job --workspace_id 270969 --page_size 200 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'Succeeded|Failed|Running|EnvPreparing|Creating|Queuing' | wc -l | awk '{print "  " $1 " 个任务"}'
